stated: The Conservative Party will maintain the pace of investment in grassroots sports facilities over the next Parliament through the continuation of the Multi-Sport Grassroots Facilities Programme, expanding criteria to benefit more sports.

source.quote: We will maintain this pace of investment over the next Parliament through the continuation of the Multi-Sport Grassroots Facilities Programme. We will look to expand the criteria to ensure more sports benefit from this investment.

bearing_set.reason: Grassroots sports facilities directly support community gathering, civic participation, inter-group contact and sense of belonging — the core O15 indicators — and Sport England evidence consistently links facility access to social trust and reduced loneliness.

membership_note: The dominant material effect is on community cohesion (O15). Preventive health benefits of physical activity exist but the pathway to O3 indicators (waiting lists, GP access) is indirect and attenuated for a maintenance-of-existing-pace commitment rather than an expansion. Fiscal continuity ('maintain the pace') does not add a new O12 burden relative to baseline. No other fundamentals clear the non-negligible bar.
